product.ta-alphatronic-p2l.summary: The P2L put the computer on a single board while retaining the P2U’s capacity.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2l.history: The Triumph-Adler manual archived with a June 1983 date includes the P2L in the Alphatronic P2 office family. It shared the P2U’s memory and drive configuration in a single-board design.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2l.technical.con: The single board made the system less modular. The manual excludes the real-time clock and IEC bus options for the P2L.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2l.technical.ver: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2l.technical.lim: The model-specific firmware and a boot disk remain to be preserved for verification.
